label: UV overlap
hint: Triangulate UV polygons; use spatial buckets and positive-area triangle intersection. Adjacent faces sharing only an edge are not counted. Limited by UV-analysis budget.

ru.title: UV overlap
ru.why: Это допустимо для зеркальных/повторяемых текстур, но плохо для уникального бейка и lightmap.
ru.fix: Проверь UV Editor. Разведи острова только там, где нужен уникальный UV-атлас.
ru.mechanism: Триангулирует UV-полигоны и ищет пересечение положительной площади. Ограничивает размер анализа и число пар.
ru.exceptions: Наложение может быть намеренным (mirrored/stacked UV). Ограничение сложности вызывает SKIP, а не PASS.

en.title: UV overlap
en.what: Some UV triangles overlap with a positive area.
en.why: Overlaps are fine for mirroring and tiling but unsuitable for unique baking or lightmaps.
en.fix: Inspect the UV Editor. Separate islands only in channels that require unique coverage.
en.mechanism: Triangulates UV faces and tests positive-area intersections, with triangle and pair safety caps.
en.exceptions: Overlap can be intentional (mirrored/stacked UV). Complexity limits yield SKIP, not PASS.
